name: Hero spider (powder blue)
source: Own Blender work (procedural scripts in src/, Blender 5.2), Albretsen AS
license: Original work for Albretsen AS; free to use commercially
notes: 1960s Italian-French two-seat spider, LHD. Faces +Z, left = +X. Nodes: body, interior, windshield, windshield_frame, steering_wheel (spin about local Z), door_l / door_r (hinge origin; rotation.y -1.15 opens left, +1.15 right), wheel_fl/fr/rl/rr (r 0.30), anchors seat_driver (first-person eye), seat_passenger, exit_l, light_head_l/r, light_tail_l/r. About 7.4k exterior + 2.4k cockpit tris. Recolour via the 'paint' material.
